The Medicaid Improvement and State Flexibility Act of 2025 directly addresses the systemic inequities you’re highlighting. Paragon Health Institute’s analysis shows expansion states receive 2.4x more federal funding per low-income resident than non-expansion states like Wisconsin, while diverting resources from vulnerable children and disabled enrollees.

The bill phases down the 90% federal match for expansion populations to parity with traditional Medicaid by 2034, saving $592B by eliminating the perverse incentive to prioritize able-bodied adults over core beneficiaries. This realignment stops the fiscal punishment of responsible states that rejected ObamaCare’s expansion gimmicks.

Wasteful spending isn’t an accident—it’s baked into the current structure. Time to fund patients, not bureaucrats.
